user.title: Connect to Homestead
user.description: Homestead normally runs as a Home Assistant app and is found automatically. For a server running elsewhere, enter its address and the API token printed in its log at startup.

data_description.token: Also stored in the file api_token of the server's data folder.

hassio_confirm.title: Homestead app found
hassio_confirm.description: Add the garden {name} to Home Assistant? Its tasks, calendar and plantings will appear as entities.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: The Homestead server at {url} refused the token. Enter the current one.

abort.already_configured: This garden is already set up. Its address and token have been updated.
abort.wrong_server: This token belongs to another Homestead server.

unknown_device.message: This device is not an active planting or a space of a loaded Homestead garden.

harvest_needs_planting.message: A harvest is logged on a planting, not on a space.

log_harvest.name: Log a harvest
log_harvest.description: Adds a harvest to a planting. The first harvest moves it to the harvesting stage.

log_journal.name: Write in the journal
log_journal.description: Records a watering, a feed, a treatment or an observation for a planting or a whole space.

device_id.name: Planting or space
device_id.description: The device of a planting or of a space.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Optional, such as litres of water.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of the amount, such as L.
